svg.title: Held-out log R-squared, Model A against Model B
svg.desc: Grouped bars for four algorithms. Model A with league and club context scores 0.836 to 0.891; Model B without it scores 0.585 to 0.669.
svg.text: CONTEXT EXPLAINS MUCH OF THE VALUE
Held-out (out-of-fold) log R², 5-fold CV on 5,820 players. Higher is better.
Model A: with league and club context
Model B: performance and profile only
Source: docs/reports/MODEL_EVALUATION.md §1–2 (reports/models/). Median error = median absolute error in EUR.
